title: Observability and Fault Injection for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems in Software Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2608.24271v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Model-based multi-agent systems are increasingly explored for software engineering tasks, but they remain difficult to inspect, debug, and evaluate under controlled failures. We present llmmas-otel, a lightweight and framework-agnostic tool that combines OpenTelemetry-based distributed tracing with fault injection for LLM-based multi-agent systems in software engineering workflows. The tool instruments agent executions with trace-aligned telemetry across workflow phases, agent steps, inter-agent communication, tool calls, and LLM invocations, and supports targeted fault injection at selected interaction points. This makes it possible to compare baseline and faulty executions in a reproducible way and inspect the effects through aligned traces and run artifacts. translated_title: 基于LLM的多智能体系统在软件工程中的可观测性与故障注入研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24271v1 公告类型：新 摘要：基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统越来越多地被探索用于软件工程任务，但它们在受控故障条件下仍难以检查、调试和评估。我们提出了llmmas-otel，一个轻量级且框架无关的工具，它将基于OpenTelemetry的分布式追踪与故障注入相结合，用于软件工程工作流中基于LLM的多智能体系统。该工具通过跨工作流阶段、智能体步骤、智能体间通信、工具调用和LLM调用的轨迹对齐遥测来检测智能体执行，并支持在选定交互点进行针对性故障注入。这使得能够以可复现的方式比较基线和故障执行，并通过对齐轨迹和运行产物检查其影响。我们描述了该工具的动机、架构、实现、当前能力，并在一个最小演示工作流和一个真实的基于LLM的m上进行了初步验证。
tldr: 本文介绍了一个轻量级工具llmmas-otel，通过结合分布式追踪和故障注入，实现了对软件工程中基于LLM的多智能体系统的可观测性和可控故障测试。
en_tdlr: This paper presents llmmas-otel, a lightweight tool that combines distributed tracing with fault injection to enable observability and controlled fault testing for LLM-based multi-agent systems in software engineering.
